title: Shopify vs Squarespace for Selling Online
h1: Shopify vs Squarespace for selling online
description: Shopify and Squarespace compared for online selling: product range, checkout, apps, design, content, fees and who each platform suits.
intro: Both Shopify and Squarespace let you sell online without building a store from scratch. Shopify is designed around selling and offers deep store features. Squarespace is a website builder with store tools, and is often chosen by brands that care about design and content. This article compares them for small sellers and explains what to ask a freelancer.

faq.q: Which is better for many products?
faq.a: Shopify is built for larger catalogs and growth, with strong inventory and app support.

faq.q: Which is better for a design-led brand with few products?
faq.a: Squarespace is attractive for polished sites with a small catalog and plenty of content.
Fees depend on the plan and payment method. Check current terms before choosing.

faq.q: Can I sell services or bookings?
faq.a: Both can, with different tools. Compare the features for appointments and digital products.
Both are hosted, so updates are handled for you. Shopify adds more settings and apps to manage as the store grows.
